Reviewers mostly see Guidde as a simple, fast way to make step-by-step tutorials and product walkthroughs, with repeated praise for its easy interface, polished output, AI voiceover, annotations, and time savings versus manual recording and editing. The fact that it uses AI to automatically generate annotations and emojis is a really cool feature that sets it apart from other similar tools.
